answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a ledge as the anchor of the cost.
